$comment: VAPP-217 (eApps U2; docs/package-format.md "Record macros"): THE HOST FILL of the RecordForm and RecordTable macros, replayed by the TS reference (src/host/record-macros.ts fillRecordMacros, called by templateMessages and validatePackage's component check) and the Rust core (host::record_macros::fill_record_macros, template_messages). A macro sees only its node's props, so the host fills every RecordForm / RecordTable of a template's flat component list from the package's records before the reducer runs; macros.json then expands them (fixtures/catalog-macros.json RecordForm/* + RecordTable/*). FIELDS (recordFormFields, in the Data tab's order: required in order, then the rest by name; files left out): label = the name humanized (closeDate / close_date → Close date), placeholder = the schema description; a member ref → Select source exp:members, an issue ref → Select source exp:issues (both searchable); boolean → switch; number → number (min/max from the schema), integer → number with step 1, precision 0; array of enum items → a multiple Select, other arrays → chips (wide, max = maxLength); string enum → select; format date → date, time → time, date-time → text with the placeholder YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM; a string without maxLength or longer than 200 → textarea (wide); else text. value = {path: <draft path>/<name>}. CHECKS: required (not a switch) → required / $string.required; a free string's maxLength → length max / $string.invalidValue; a number's minimum/maximum → numeric / $string.invalidValue. RecordForm: path = the author's or /recordForm/<id>; on.submit (unless the author wrote one) = records.upsert {kind, id: the author's recordId when given, data: one binding per field}; a read-only viewer → readOnly. RecordTable (base = /recordTable/<id>): title = the kind's title or its name humanized; cols = the chosen columns (default every field, unknown names and files dropped), number/integer → type number align end, boolean → boolean, date → date, fixed widths by format/type (date 104, time 64, date-time 152, number/integer 64, boolean 56), else truncate; then updatedAt (relativeTime, 136) and, when editable, the menu slot column (80); rows = base/rows/rows, count = fill $string.recordCount {count}, loading = not(base/rows); children = the phone row template <id>__row (appended: a Row, title = the first column as text else —, subtitle = the second, meta = the relative updatedAt, press = open the editor on the row); the binding base/rows ← records:<kind>?<query without its ?, default sort=updatedAt&order=desc> appended to the template's. Editable (the author's editable !== false and not a read-only viewer): fields/path over base/editor/draft, editorOpen/editorId/deleteOpen bindings, on.add/edit/delete/submit/cancel/confirm/cancelDelete (each only when the author wrote none): add = set base/editor {open, draft: {}}, edit = set base/editor {open, draft: the row}, delete = set base/delete {open, id: the row's id}, submit = records.upsert with id = the draft's id, cancel / cancelDelete = close, confirm = records.delete {id: base/delete/id}. Not editable: add false. An undeclared kind fills only missing: true (the unknown state). INSTALL (validatePackage, at the macro's component): a writing RecordForm (not readOnly) or editable RecordTable needs records.upsert in functions; an editable RecordTable also records.delete; a RecordTable's records:<kind> must pass sources when sources is set.
